name: Slash
description: An open source, self-hosted links shortener and sharing platform.
composeYaml:
services:
  slash:
    image: yourselfhosted/slash:latest
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'slash-data:/var/opt/slash'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:5231'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15

meta.about: An open source, self-hosted bookmarks and link sharing platform.
